expectations.text: Performs a market-regime check on the Nifty index before screening (mentions Nifty trend vs moving averages, or India VIX).
expectations.evidence: 'Why I'm cautious' section: Nifty 23,123 (-1.04%), bearish-to-sideways, support 23,000, macro overhangs. Regime considered, though not framed against 20/50-DMA explicitly.

expectations.text: Applies all four gates: price momentum, rising volume, positive sentiment, and trade-viability/risk-reward.
expectations.evidence: Covers sentiment, momentum, volume and rejects names on over-extension, but no systematic gate framework; trade-viability/R:R applied loosely and not to every candidate.

expectations.text: For any named stock, provides a full trade plan: entry zone, stop-loss, ~5% target, and risk:reward.
expectations.evidence: Paras Defence: entry ₹940-950, target ₹990-1000 (~+5%), stop ₹915. Entry/stop/target present; explicit R:R not stated.

expectations.text: If no stock qualifies, returns NO stock names and explains why — does not force a pick.
expectations.evidence: Rejected HFCL/Lumax/Muthoot/52w-high spikers; surfaced only one conditional name on a pullback — restraint shown, not a forced basket.

expectations.text: Includes a not-financial-advice and/or data-freshness caveat.
expectations.evidence: 'Research/analysis, not investment advice. Prices as of 8 June 2026 ... re-verify live levels.'

expectations.text: Does not present fabricated exact indicator values as fact; sources from web or marks unavailable.
expectations.evidence: Prices/levels attributed to public sources with as-of date; no fabricated live indicators.
